prompt: Create a cinematic full-body portrait of a young Japanese female samurai warrior standing in a misty autumn temple garden. She wears an ornate black and deep crimson patterned kimono integrated with layered samurai armor: lacquered red shoulder plates, segmented waist and thigh guards, black leather bracers, gold floral embroidery, brocade fabric, and a dark obi belt. She holds one katana at her side with the hilt near her hand, and a second sheathed sword is visible at her waist; include exactly 2 swords. Her pose is calm and powerful, body angled slightly sideways, head turned toward the viewer with a serious, elegant expression. She has long dark hair loosely tied back with windblown strands around her face. Add a wide woven straw kasa hat with dangling red tassels and small gold ornaments; include exactly 4 prominent tassel clusters hanging from the brim. The background shows a softly blurred Japanese pagoda on the left, stone steps below, a massive dark tree trunk on the right, and dense red maple foliage overhead. Add scattered falling red maple leaves, atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim light, soft backlighting through the trees, realistic skin, intricate textile detail, and a moody red-black-gold color palette. Style: ultra-detailed photorealistic fantasy fashion editorial, cinematic composition, vertical 3:4 frame, high dynamic range, natural lens bokeh, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影感全身肖像，主角为 年轻的日本女武士，站在雾气缭绕的秋日寺庙花园中。她身着华丽的黑色与深红色花纹和服，并融合了层叠的武士盔甲：漆红肩甲、分段式腰甲与腿甲、黑色皮质护腕、金色花卉刺绣、锦缎面料以及深色腰带。她手持一把武士刀，刀柄靠近手部，腰间可见另一把收鞘的刀；要求包含 2 把刀。她的姿态沉稳而有力，身体略微侧向，头部转向观众，表情严肃而优雅。她留着长长的黑发，随意束在脑后，几缕发丝随风飘动。戴着一顶宽大的草编斗笠，斗笠上垂下红色流苏和小型金色装饰；要求斗笠边缘悬挂 4 簇明显的流苏。背景左侧为虚化的日本宝塔，下方是石阶，右侧是一棵巨大的深色树干，上方是茂密的红枫叶。画面中加入飘落的红枫叶、大气雾气、浅景深、戏剧性的轮廓光、穿过树木的柔和背光、写实的皮肤质感、复杂的织物细节，以及深沉的红、黑、金配色方案。风格：超精细写实奇幻时尚大片，电影级构图，垂直 3:4 画幅，高动态范围，自然镜头虚化，无文字，无水印。
